nom: ANUA 3 Ceramide Panthenol Moisture Barrier Cream

avis.texte: I have oily and acne prone sensitive skin but am also in my mid-30s and live in the high desert and this moisturizer keeps my skin hydrated, supple, and smooth, soothing any irritations that may arise from the harsh climate I live in, without any acne causing ingredients. I love the thicker texture that doesn't feel too heavy and the way it makes my skin feel. Whenever I use it I know I'm taking good care of my skin. I have repurchased over 5 times.

Most Asian beauty products have ingredients that will clog my pores (very comedogenic), but Anua has so much to offer those who have acne-prone skin! This barrier cream is a good, thick moisturizer for soothing and repairing my barrier-damaged skin around my mouth/nose area. I use tret for my acne and this helps counteract the dryness it can create. I already ordered two more tubes. It is a much cheaper option than my other favorite moisturizer from a brand that has been under scrutiny recently haha
one of the best light weight moisturizers that doesn't leave your face feeling greasy! Gives you a glow!

I have super dry, dehydrated skin and I'm always trying new moisturizers because I'm never satisfied. But this one is so good, I'm actually going to buy it again when I run out. I'm three months in and very happy with it.

I loved the anua heartleaf sunscreen (not widely sold in the US) so I decided to pick up this barrier cream when I ran out of my usual La Roche Posay moisturizer. After 1.5 weeks of regular use, I had deep red pimples on my cheeks and chin that I'm still recovering from. :/ Would avoid if you have sensitive/ acne-prone skin, or if a moisturizer has ever broken you out. However -- the texture is really nice and I could see this working well for people whose main concern is dryness.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: This is an amazing product I really love how moisturized and dewy my skin feels after using this product. i love to pair it with anua's heartleaf 70 daily lotion when I apply my retinol and it makes sure that there's 0 irritation after or during using it. However I would reccomend something less oil/heavy if you have an oily skin type I don't think it would pair well and could even break some people out. So overall great product you just have to be concious of your skin type.
It sorta got rid of my dryness but it just sat on my skin. It made my face really oily looking and didn't do to much. It broke my nose and chin out. Overall I wouldn't recommend this anua product

I had overused a mandelic acid serum and my skin started peeling as a result. Started looking up ceramide barrier moisturizers and this one popped up. I've been using it for about a month and my skin no longer had that peeling issue. I just love how it makes my skin feel moisturized afterwards too and it's not greasy at all. It's somehow thick but light at the same time. Will henceforth be a staple product in my skincare routine. You got this product right Anua!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I have been really impressed with this lotion. It absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling, which is especially important during the hot summer months. It layers beautifully under makeup and keeps my skin feeling hydrated throughout the day. It's lightweight, comfortable to wear, and has become a staple in my skincare routine. I will definitely be purchasing it again.

My skin barrier got pretty damaged from sun exposure, new products, exfoliants, etc. but this is genuinely a miracle product. It's like the LaRoche Posay double repair moisturizer but better because it hydrates deeper, doesn't pill, and lays beautifully under makeup. I use this AM and PM and it's never caused me to break out. I use it at night after applying my retinal and I've noticed my skin is less irritated and less sensitive to the sun the next day. It's also made a noticeable difference in my fine lines/dehydration lines. It's so affordable and the product lasts forever; I've had it for almost 2 months and I'm not even halfway through the bottle yet.

avis.titre: This is a beautiful face cream!
avis.texte: Let me start by prefacing that I am a 38 year old woman starting perimenopause, and while I used to be acne prone into my late twenties, I have since then seen my skin change. I have not purchased a product specifically for acne in a long while. ANYWAY! I've been in the process of switching my skincare routine because what I was using before wasn't it. I love me some barrier care, but I didn't want to start off with an intense rich cream first because I wasn't sure how my skin would take to a big overhaul so I went with this. Putting this cream on as a last step is DIVINE. I don't know what it is but it just feels so silky and smooth and my skin absolutely drinks this up. No break outs, no redness, just happy moisturized skin. I do find that this may not be moisturizing enough for night time so I'll opt for a richer cream in the evenings, but for daytime this is AMAZING. A big bonus is the size for the price. Such a winner!

avis.titre: Great moisturizing relief for my dry skin.
avis.texte: I have dry skin and whenever I cleanse, it feels tight afterwards. I came across this barrier cream on an IG Reel from a girl who tried multiple and this one of her top ranked ones. I like this a lot because it's fairly inexpensive, it doesn't feel heavy on my skin, it gives my skin a sublte glow, it doesn't pill under my sunscreen and makeup, and when it fully dries, my skin still has that glow and feels soft. This is going to be a staple in my daily skincare routine.

avis.titre: Finally a great, calming, deeply moisturising product
avis.texte: I have acne-prone sensitive dry-leaning combination skin, and this moisturiser feels extremely deeply moisturising! It feels like it immediately quenches my dry skin without irritating it. The texture is creamy and thick-ish which is exactly what I was looking for. I was tired of all the "lightweight" moisturisers that were never quite sufficient for my dry skin, especially during colder months. This product was the perfect solution.
I love the texture of this because it's not too heavy but it definitely does what it needs to in terms of fixing my barrier. Can wear during day without feeling greasy.

All of the ingredients are acne safe according to acneclinicnyc website. im a testimony because my acne hasnt flared up, and actually cleared up insanely quick while using this. This calms irritated skin. This is the only moisturizer with 3 ceramides and panthenol all in one while also being completely clean. I used to use this by itself, but also got prescribed tret two months ago and this pairs insanely well with that too. No matter your routine, it just works so well. Barrier health is insanely important. My skin is so happy!

I use this as my PM moisturizer and I love it. I have combo/oily acne prone skin and it hasn't caused any issues. I even notice a difference in the morning in terms of hydration and softness in my skin
To be fair, I haven't tried alot of moisturizers, but this one feels very light and nice and leaves my face feeling smooth. Could it cure acne. No. Does it cause it? Not for me.

I have been using this every day since 16th February 2026! I am 39 years old with sensitive skin (Rosacea). My skin has been happy!!!!!!!! I am going to keep using this product as part of my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Finally a moisturizer for sensitive skin that doesn't BURN!
avis.texte: I have tried multiple moisturizers marketed for sensitive skin, but this one truly meets the criteria. It doesn't burn when I put it on my skin, and I wake up with my skin feeling so hydrated. My acne is improving since this moisturizer is greatly helping my skin barrier. I bought this on a whim and I'm so glad that I did!!

avis.titre: Great moisturizer with no pore clogging ingredients
avis.texte: I use this 2x a day after cleansing and skin care and love the way it makes my skin feel. I have acne/psoriasis/eczema prone skin and had no issues with this!

I bought this on a whim because my skin seems to like panthenol. Woke up the next day and I felt like my redness was calmer than usual, and my skin felt so even. After a few days of use, im impressed with how balanced and calm my skin feels. A random picked that turned out to be great!

avis.titre: Finally a cream for sensitive skin that doesn't burn!!!!
avis.texte: I've tried countless moisturizers- basically all of the most recommended ones for sensitive skin. Almost all of them burn my skin or leave me feeling dry and dehydrated. My skin didnt burn at all using this product which is rare for me and my skin actually felt hydrated. Please never discontinue this cream!

I had a pretty bad broken skin barrier, and have had red sensitive skin for awhile. but using this has brought down my redness and honestly love this so much, def worth the money. I just finished my first bottle.

avis.titre: From a sensitive skin girlie: this stuff rocks
avis.texte: I am not one to leave reviews on skincare. Ever. Mostly because I have insanely fussy skin and most products just don't work for me. I recently defeated a stubborn, years long case of perioral dermatitis and was looking for a gentle moisturizer. Trust me I've tried many if not all of the other "gentle" ones. I truly love this stuff because it doesn't contain the typical fatty alcohols (cetyl/cetearyl/stearyl) that give me juicy pimples or niacinamide, which burns my face quite a bit in any concentration. This really calms my redness and does not aggravate my dermatitis. Which is a small miracle. The first time I tried it I looked at my husband and said "this cream may be amazing because I forgot I had it on". Any sensitive skin friends out there you know what I'm talking about. Any time I've tried a new product I'm always feeling something: a burn, a tingle, an itch. This just felt…calm. Anua please don't alter the formulation or get rid of this because I will cry real tears. I am so happy to have a moisturizer that I can continue to purchase and not worry if it will hurt me or not!

This is by far Anua's best moisturizer, from my experience. It's acne/pore clogger safe (I've checked the ingredients), and it feels so nice to apply to the skin. No fragrance, absorbs well, and hydrates well. A little goes a long way. It really helps to tone down acne induced redness, and redness in general. My holy grail moisturizer. I won't use anything else! Anua really nailed it with this one, in my opinion.
If you have clinically dry, clog prone, sensative skin—please try this.
My face is slightly sensitive and I've read good things about this, but when I did a spot test on the back of my hand I IMMEDIATELY started to get a red, splotchy rash that burned.
This moisturizer is pretty lightweight, it hydrates the skin and makes it soft. I use this at night as my last step to my skincare routine. I would recommend!
I love this moisturizer. It leaves my skin feeling so soft without feeling heavy on my face.
New favorite moisturizer. I stocked up. Not greasy but so hydrating. Leaves tbe perfect glow.

This is such a luxurious and hydrating barrier cream. This cream has a rich, creamy consistency but does not feel heavy after applying. It absorbs nicely into the skin. I like that it creates a comfortable, protective layer over the skin to help lock in moisture. My skin feels calm and less dry after use. I like that the cream can help strengthen the skin barrier and keep my skin feeling hydrated and protected. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.
Hydartes skin and repairs barried not as hydrating as you might need if using otber products like ninamicide but other than that its great

I decided to buy it because my skin was freaking out by using too many acids on my skin. My skin was breaking out and everything i put on it burned. I have oily skin and usually only use gel moisturizers. But i looked at the ingredients and saw some reviews that it was lightweight so i took a chance with this moisturizer. Im so glad i did!! I only use it at night because i use gel moisturizers in the morning, and i wake up to healthy glowy skin. So even if you have oily skin, i still recommend it but it is indeed lightweight!

avis.titre: Best Moisturizer for Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: This is the best moisturizer ever! Its not too thick where it clogs my pores but its not too thin where it doesnt leave my skin feeling dehydrated. At night i apply 2 layers to really lock in all that moisture. Ive noticed amazing results from this product
I have very sensitive, eczema prone skin and this has helped so much. It leaves my skin soft and smooth and gives a very nice glow that lasts all day.

This is my new favorite. It is very hydrating without being heavy. I have super tight dry skin after washing my face and water creams are too light but hydrating moisturizers are often heavy and suffocating. THIS IS PERFECT. Also ended up giving me less acne than my previous moisturizer
I would recomend this product if you were looking for a simple fast drying non peeling everyday moisurizer it's very thin which might not be great for everyone but it's nice. Also rosacea friendly :)

I used this moisturizer at night on my acne -rosacea skin, and my skin loved it! It left my skin well moisturized and glowy, and absorbed well into my skin. I think it is a silicone based moisturizer, which might be polarizing for some people. I've since tried another brand's barrier cream, and it is not near as moisturizing as this one. This Anua moisturizer is a great basic, non-irritating addition for colder months.
Love the spatial moisturizer. It's not oily yet still hydrating. It goes on smooth and doesn't take much when applied. I highly recommend this.

This product is way too tacky and I would say a slate grease feeling to it. I can't get past 10 minutes without wanting to wipe it off. I did find that if I only apply a drop, then it works fine. It's just some things that I won't be purchasing.

avis.titre: I love it but it's sticky
avis.texte: I absolutely love the consistency of this product. It's like rubbing pure silk on my face. It leaves a glowing finish. I was more than anything it was so sticky. It doesn't dry down so when I go to sleep, my face literally sticks to my pillowcase. But I really do love this product regardless.

avis.titre: Not sure if I will purchase this.
avis.texte: As much as, I want to write all the ingredients that are NOT helping me achieve a much more natural product. It is better for everyone to just search them all by themselves. Because they're really long. 😅 This is a bit more of Silicone ingredients, some synthetic polymer (as a stabilizer, texture enhancer etc). There's Vitamin B5 (panthenol). I did use this together with Intensive Moisturizing Milk Lotion and for more hydration. There's some good natural ingredients as well that helps my skin but I can't say this is going to be my favourite.

I think Anna might be one of my new favorite brands. The Anna 3 Ceraimide Panthenol Moisture Barrier Cream is a great product. This product is lightweight and melts into your skin while deeply hydrating and restoring your skin barrier. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for an honest review.

This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. This Anua 3 Ceramide Panthenol Moisture Barrier Cream is amazing! Super hydrating and moisturizing. As a dry skin girl I really enjoy this barrier cream and so does my skin.

avis.titre: Not what I expected — caused breakouts
avis.texte: I have dry and somewhat sensitive skin, and I bought this product hoping for hydration without clogging my pores. From the first application, I noticed the texture was very heavy and greasy, and it didn't absorb well. After a few days of use, I started getting breakouts in areas where I don't usually have acne, especially on my forehead and cheeks. My skin also felt congested and looked overly shiny, even when using a small amount. It might work better for extremely dry skin types, but unfortunately, it didn't work for me. I stopped using it and my skin started to improve. I wouldn't repurchase or recommend it for sensitive or breakout-prone skin.

avis.titre: they tried aka anua but a no for them
avis.texte: I honestly do not like this product at all. Im trying to repair my barrier, i saw this product advertised over tiktok so I got it for my dry acne prone sensitive skin. Big mistake, made my skin so red ALL DAY. It didnt relax like at all. My skin likes barrier repair ingredients and centella, I dont know why it irritated my skin. I like the concept of this product, only positive thing i can say. The product went into the trash

avis.titre: Perfect for dry, acne-prone, reactive skin!
avis.texte: This past winter, my skin decided it wanted to freak out. My acne hasnt been this terrible since my teens - deep, painful hormonal breakouts on my cheeks and chin. I developed psoriasis along my hairline and ears that was painful to the touch. I tried a lot of products over the past 7 months and while my skin isn't perfect again, I finally have a regimen down that has seems to keep my skin calm and happy. My main concern was delivering moisture to my skin to keep the psoriasis at bay, without causing more breakouts in the process, and without being too heavy for the humid Chicago summers. This moisturizer is incredible! It's very rich, but not too heavy for daytime wear. It does take a while to fully dry down, but it doesnt pill with other products and makeup looks dewy and smooth over top. It doesn't feel like it's suffocating my skin. I am a very sweaty person and I never feel like I have the dreaded sweat mustache that a heavy moisturizer will usually give me. For nighttime, it's a dream. I usually slather on a thick layer to seal in the rest of my skincare, and again my skin feels soothed and not smothered. I wake up with glowy and bouncy skin and any redness I had before bed is significantly calmed down. I love it and I will repurchase again and again! A little goes a long way. I've had my first tube for over a month and I'm barely half way through.

I really struggle with dry skin because moist moisturizing lotions aren't strong enough and creams are too thick but THIS is perfect for me. Super lightweight, glowy results, and left my skin feeling hydrated. It keeps my skin hydrated all day. I received this product for promotional purpose in exchange for my review.

I really struggle with dry skin because moist moisturizing lotions aren't strong enough and creams are too thick but THIS is perfect for me. Super lightweight, glowy results, and left my skin feeling hydrated.

Before using this product, I was using the Glow recipe plump plump cream, and I thought it was great but kinda expensive for the amount of product you get, so I tried Korean skincare a.k.a this product because I heard that u can get better for cheaper. Overall I love this product! ❤️❤️❤️

I am really impressed with this product,it revived my dehydrated and irritated combination acne prone skin in less than a week!my skin barrier is happy and stronger .no greasy feeling it's really soothing on the skin This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review

The Anua 3 Ceramide Panthenol Moisture Barrier Cream is a lifesaver for my skin barrier. It has a rich, creamy texture that feels instantly comforting but doesn't clog pores or feel too heavy. It creates a soft, breathable seal that locks in moisture without being greasy. It's fragrance-free, gentle, and perfect for sensitive or damaged skin. This is one of those barrier creams I'll keep reaching for all year round.

Really amazing moisturizer to add along with the other Anua skincare products seen such an amazing smoothness on my skin!! I use this after the Anua toner and glow pads to see ultimate results skins so moisturized and healthy and glowing!! I will keep using these as my skin keeps looking better and better with each use!!

This moisturizer is so soothing, and lightweight. I'm 53, with very dry skin, and this has made a world of difference. I used to dread doing my skincare routine because it didn't seem like anything was helping, but everything I've used from this company has been a real winner!!!! I highly suggest you try it!!!!!!!!

avis.titre: The only moisturizer you'll ever need
